oxlint.necessity: Measures native lint findings in shadow mode.

storybook.necessity: Provides the Storybook build and test CLI.

tsx.necessity: Runs the deterministic Astro validation wrapper.

typescript-eslint.necessity: Provides supported ESLint flat TypeScript configuration.

vitest.necessity: Runs local plugin and quality checker fixtures.

wrangler.necessity: Provides the lockfile-pinned Cloudflare Pages deployment executable for the marketing workspace.

yaml.necessity: Structurally parses GitHub workflow contracts in security regression tests.
